embodiment.name: Compact 3R
embodiment.solver: Damped least squares with joint bounds, command slew limits and a null-space posture preference

selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoints; no test-based selection
limitations: Compact planar 3R, not a humanoid or full 3D manipulator
No vision/language inputs to the policy
Only three training seeds and twenty paired task cases
Post-training receives extra simulator data; frozen transfer has no target training
Known tool radius is engineered embodiment information
followup_baseline_note: CompactGeometry was implemented after the initial comparison, inspected on validation seed 7131, and retained as an additional baseline. Original results are preserved.
